Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated basophils. Chloride is mildly elevated. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or systemic illness; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
